review_description: The sales and quoting process was the only good thing.The installation was horrendous from the start I was told the work would be done in a day, the first day Tuesday there was a slight possibility of rain, so they packed and left leaving my garage full of panels and equipment (no room for cars) and I was told that they would be back on Friday because other work was booked (as was mine) the tiles on my house are Terra Cotta and because of this they need special attention for which I was charged an additional $1,000.00, prior to the work I purchased 20 additional tiles just in case of breakage.The two installers treated my roof like a break-dancing stage and therefore broke at least 36 tiles that I was aware of I since discovered that there were at least 12 that had been supposably repaired, there was also sections of rail not secured and several fixing bolts left loose and, in the gutter, sections of cut rail and bolts left on the grass.These complaints were brought and to some degree addressed with addition tiles supplied and a promise of 4 panel cleans over the next 2 years which did not happen.The reason I am writing this review is last week after a heavy storm we had a major roof leak the cause of which was a tile broken clean in half across its length and patched with sisalation tape and silicon a job my wife's mother could do better, goodness knows what other carnage is left under the solar panels.Please think twice before engaging this company.

Quote was done very quickly, beating 4 other local companies for price and also using much better panels (475w vs 415)They showed up when they said they would and did a good, tidy installation and left the place as clean as when they arrived. Nice blokes, informative & bonus points for having an apprentice.Grid connection was seamless, app installedGladly recommend them

I was recommended Unlimited Power Solutions from a family friend who had recently had them install a system. They provided up front honest and clear explanation of the process and quote.Having sought quotes from other installers, I ended up using Unlimited Power Solutions as I found their product, service and price to be the best available to me.  I would highly recommend Unlimited Power Solutions to anyone wishing to invest in solar installations.

I couldn't be happier, I believe I got great value.The installation  went exactly as expected, the installers were polite, tidy and punctual.The completed job has had some of my neighbours asking many questions and of course all with a great interest.Not sure what happens about grid connection, I am awaiting feedback from anyone on this.

Alex and Phil were super helpful to design the system, answer all my questions and then promptly installed the system and did a fantastic job of it. They kept my informed along the way from asking for a quote to finalising the install. The install was neat and tidy, they cleaned up the site and left it as they found it and they were good for a chat afterwards. Their price was good and I'm one happy customer.

They were recommended by a friend, they turned up to do the quote on time & informative.They are qualified electricians so the installation was done to standard unlike my previous installation which was done on price & not quality, this is the main reason I used them as my previous smaller installation was cheap & when I had an issue they could not be contacted, these guys are locals and trustworthy, I paid a bit more for piece of mind.
